newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal barely changed, deposits steady.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal barely changed, deposits steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was little changed against the dollar in quiet trade this week and riyal interbank deposit rates were steady.
Dealers in the kingdom said activity focused on short dates. Spot-next was put at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and one-week deposits were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent.
"Riyal rates were mainly steady. There were no changes," one Riyadh-based dealer said. The spot Saudi riyal was quoted at 3.7505/07 to the dollar, slightly down from 3.7504/06 last week.
One-month interbank deposit rates were at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16, six months were 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were at 6-5/16, 3/16.
